property_summary: After the Owner calls Command with an adr that reverts on receiving a bare transfer, the correct contract (using call) does not revert, but the mutant (using transfer) does, so a succeeding Command call invariant is violated by the mutant.
change_summary: Replace 'adr.call{value: msg.value}(data)' with 'payable(adr).transfer(msg.value)', changing the call behavior and forwarded ether amount.
